overview: The Traffic Commission addressed various traffic safety, parking, and regulatory matters across the city. The commission approved several new parking restrictions, crosswalks, a stop sign, and an updated 2025 parking fee schedule, while denying a requested stop sign on Central Avenue in favor of a police traffic study.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the October 8, 2024 meeting.

items.title: Gourley Road Resident Permit Parking (2024-58)
items.summary: Approved resident permit parking on Gourley Road from George Street to Summer Street, with the park side restricted to three-hour parking during the day and permit parking overnight.

items.title: Marion Street Corner Parking Restrictions (2024-59)
items.summary: Approved "no parking here to corner" signage on Marion Street at Winchester Street, establishing a 25-foot restriction on the south side and posting signage to reinforce the fire hydrant clearance on the north side.

items.title: 119 Bowdoin Street Accessible Parking Space (2024-60)
items.summary: Approved a designated on-street accessible parking space in front of 119 Bowdoin Street.

items.title: Central Avenue Stop Sign Request (2024-61)
items.summary: Denied a petition for a stop sign on Central Avenue at Poole Street or Linwood Street, referring the location to the police department traffic division for a speed study and increased enforcement.

items.title: Winchester Street Crosswalks (2024-62)
items.summary: Approved painting pedestrian crosswalks across Winchester Street at Newburn Avenue, Morton Avenue, and Granville Avenue.

items.title: 310 Lawrence Road Crosswalk Daylighting (2024-63)
items.summary: Approved a 20-foot "no parking anytime" restriction on the north side of Lawrence Road approaching the crosswalk at Rural Avenue to improve pedestrian sightlines.

items.title: Fulbright Street Traffic Regulations (2024-64)
items.summary: Conditionally approved a stop sign, stop bar, and no-parking restrictions on Fulbright Street at Mystic Avenue, subject to engineering verification of the street's public or private status.

items.title: Landlord Parking Permits (2024-65)
items.summary: Approved establishing a landlord parking permit program permitting property owners to purchase annual permits tied to a specific vehicle and street.

items.title: Clippership East Lot Business Parking (2024-65)
items.summary: Approved designating the Clippership East municipal lot for business permit parking.

items.title: Healthcare Parking Permit Expansion (2024-65)
items.summary: Approved allowing healthcare parking permit holders to utilize designated business parking areas.

items.title: 2025 Parking Fee Schedule (2024-65)
items.summary: Approved a revised parking permit fee structure taking effect February 1, 2025, introducing tiered residential parking permit pricing and increases for business and commuter permits.

items.title: Whittemore Street Stop Sign (2024-66)
items.summary: Approved installing a stop sign on Whittemore Street at Edward Street.

items.title: Locust Street Right Turn on Red Restriction (2024-67)
items.summary: Approved prohibiting right turns on red from Locust Street onto Riverside Avenue to protect pedestrians crossing Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Harvard Avenue at Monument Street Corner Parking (2024-51)
items.summary: Removed from the table and approved 30-foot "no parking here to corner" restrictions on Harvard Avenue at the northeast and southeast corners of Monument Street.
